title: Plus adds numbers before it concatenates
statement: In an expression that mixes strings and numbers with +, the numbers are added together first and the string is attached afterwards.

evidence_patterns.signature: adds the numeric operands regardless of their position

discriminators.vs_slip: Consistent across items; the learner explains that 'plus means add'. A slip is one wrong prediction.

conflicts_with.label: Operators of equal precedence apply left to right

resolved_by.label: Operators of equal precedence apply left to right

sources.citation: Chiodini, L., Moreno Santos, I., Gallidabino, A., Tafliovich, A., Santos, A. L., & Hauswirth, M. (2021). A curated inventory of programming language misconceptions. In Proceedings of the 26th ACM Conference on Innovation and Technology in Computer Science Education (ITiCSE '21), 380-386.
